@Ali Raza @Carine Abou Jaoude please see client feedback below

Status on the current options

FORTA: The only one we may take into consideration. It goes as an applicable candidate.
FUELINE, PULSE, VOLTRASTREAM: Not proceeding. The reasons are built into the criteria below.

Context to design around

The product is a UC-V4 electric fuel pump, made in Taiwan. "Made in Taiwan" will be a visible quality cue on the pack.
Buyers are B2B: parts traders, workshops, and agri/generator/marine dealers across Egypt, the Gulf, and Africa. The name has to work at a trade counter, said out loud, across Arabic, French, and English.
One pump today, but the name must not be tied to "fuel" or "pump" so it can carry other products later.

Criteria for every new candidate

No letters P or V. Arabic lacks these sounds, so they become B and F at the counter (e.g., Pulse becomes "Bulse").
5 to 7 letters, two syllables, coined rather than a dictionary word. Hard consonants preferred.
Not descriptive of the product. Descriptive names are weak to register and easy to copy.
Pronounceable and free of negative meanings.
Not within one letter of an existing car model or major parts brand (for example, FORTA sits close to Kia Forte, which is a known risk we are screening)

Headline: Demand is up. Is your stock?​
CTA: Lock in your season order. WhatsApp us your part list.​
Parts: Spark plugs, piston rings and cylinder liners, con-rod bearings.​

Maybe ASV should be positioned as a full destination, not just a hotel.

Observatory experience

Indoor + heat-proof experiences
